_comment: Read by scripts/lib/destructive-guard.ps1 (wsl-sh.ps1, server-sh.ps1) and scripts/hooks/destructive-guard.mjs, so the two cannot drift. Regexes are matched case-insensitively, one line at a time, in .NET and JavaScript: use only syntax both share. Every pattern needs a harmless `sample` (an echo): the tests send it through the guards and expect it refused.

patterns.why: DROP TABLE / DATABASE / ROLE removes data or schema
DELETE FROM removes rows; test rows go through clean-test-event.ps1
compose down -v deletes the named volumes (database, n8n data)
pg_restore --clean drops objects before restoring (case-insensitive, so -C is caught too)
docker system prune --volumes deletes unused volumes
touches volume data directly on disk
